semantics.summary: A composition contains software-component prototypes, and every such prototype is typed by a software-component type.

targets.evidence: which in turn are typed by a SwComponentType

semantics.summary: A software-component prototype represents use of its referenced component type in a specific role.
semantics.rationale: This explains prototype semantics and adds no separate structural condition beyond the type reference.

targets.evidence: usage of a SwComponentType in a specific role

verification.observability_reason: The prototype and type reference are explicit, but the role statement is descriptive.

semantics.summary: Any number of software-component prototypes may refer to the same component type.
semantics.rationale: The statement permits reuse and warns against imposing a false uniqueness or upper-cardinality rule.

verification.observability_reason: Reference multiplicity is visible, but the rule permits rather than rejects states.

curation.notes: Negative guidance: do not add uniqueness on TYPE-TREF destinations.

semantics.summary: Ports on a composition surface are delegation ports that expose inner behavior, unlike ports on atomic components.
semantics.rationale: This is an architectural interpretation; concrete delegation connector obligations are stated elsewhere.

targets.evidence: also exposes PortPrototypes to the outside world

verification.observability_reason: Surface ports and connectors are visible, but the paragraph itself does not require one specific connector for every port.

curation.notes: Use as context for delegation rules.

semantics.summary: A composition-surface port follows delegation compatibility rules and explicitly controls whether an inner port is exposed.
semantics.rationale: The compatibility predicate is delegated to chapter 6, while exposure intent is a design decision not inferable from absence alone.

targets.evidence: The delegation has to follow the rules defined in chapter 6

verification.observability_reason: Existing delegation topology is checkable, but intended exposure of an unconnected inner port is not encoded here.

curation.notes: Compile only after linking the chapter 6 endpoint-compatibility atoms.

semantics.summary: The graph of composition types and the component types instantiated within them must be acyclic.
semantics.rationale: A direct or indirect self-containment cycle is a precise graph invariant over resolvable prototype type references.

eventually contains a SwComponentPrototype typed by the same CompositionSwComponentType

verification.observability_reason: All composition nodes and prototype type-reference edges can be resolved across the input document set.

semantics.summary: A composition aggregates software connectors that connect its contained component prototypes.
semantics.rationale: This introduces the connector containment relation without requiring that every composition contain connectors.

verification.observability_reason: Connector containment is explicit but optional.

semantics.summary: An assembly connector interconnects ports of component prototypes contained by a composition.
semantics.rationale: This overview defines connector purpose; same-owner and endpoint-kind rules supply the enforceable predicates.

verification.observability_reason: Both endpoint instance references are explicit, but detailed validity comes from later constraints.

semantics.summary: A delegation connector links an inner component port with an outer composition port.
semantics.rationale: The statement defines endpoint roles; kind and ownership restrictions are separate mandatory rules.

verification.observability_reason: Both delegation endpoints are explicit, but this definition adds no further predicate.

curation.notes: Use as typed context for constr_1032 and constr_1088.

semantics.summary: A delegation connector must connect inner and outer ports of the same direction kind: P-to-P or R-to-R.
semantics.rationale: Endpoint references and their resolved concrete port classes are directly observable.

curation.notes: Represent endpoint capabilities rather than string equality so PR-port extensions can be handled explicitly.

semantics.summary: When multiple delegation connectors reference one outer port, their semantics expand to the corresponding multiplicity of assembly connections.
semantics.rationale: This defines semantic expansion and does not prohibit the multiply referenced topology.

semantic is the multiplication of the AssemblySwConnectors

verification.observability_reason: The topology is observable, while the expanded runtime communication semantics are not an additional input validity condition.

semantics.summary: An unordered pair of port prototypes may be connected by at most one software connector.
